title: lepidium cuneiforme
intro: Lepidium cuneiforme, commonly known as American cress, is a perennial plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is rich in health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the prevention of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of American cress are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Lepidium cuneiforme, such as glucosinolates and phenolic compounds, are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
